FAQs

A few things worth knowing.

What types of AI videos do you create?+

AI video advertisements, AI UGC-style videos, AI avatar videos, explainer videos, product commercials, promotional videos and short-form social media content.

Do you work with international clients?+

Yes. I am based in Lagos, Nigeria and work with clients remotely, worldwide.

Can you create videos for social media advertisements?+

Yes. Social and advertising content is a core part of the work, delivered in the aspect ratios and formats each platform requires, with captions for sound-off viewing.

Do you provide scriptwriting?+

Yes. Scriptwriting and storyboarding are offered as part of a production, or as a standalone service before production begins.

Can you create AI avatar videos?+

Yes. AI avatar videos are produced using tools such as HeyGen and Synthesia, for marketing, onboarding, sales and education content.

How does your production process work?+

Six stages: discovery, research and concept, scriptwriting, AI production, editing and refinement, then delivery in the formats you need.

How can I book a discovery call?+

Use the booking page, or send your project details through the contact form, by email or on WhatsApp and we will arrange a time.
